text: Have a high school diploma or above equivalent to that in China.The original of the final academic certificate or a notarized copy. For fresh graduates, the original of the expected graduation certificate is required. For texts other than Chinese or English, notarized Chinese or English translations must also be provided.The original transcript of all courses in the final academic education stage or a notarized copy. For texts other than Chinese or English, notarized Chinese or English translations must also be provided.A valid HSK certificate or transcript (if any).A scanned copy of the first page of a passport valid for more than six months.Scanned copies of all visas on this passport (if any).A recent 6-month, bareheaded, front-facing, single-person standard ID photo (the same size as the passport photo)
